description: The image presents two bar charts illustrating the relationship between Fleiss Kappa and two different measures of ambiguity, namely Ambiguity Std and Max Ambiguity. The charts share a common y-axis label, "Fleiss Kappa," with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 in intervals of 0.2. In the left chart, the x-axis is labeled "Ambiguity Std" and displays four categories with values 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94, corresponding to Fleiss Kappa values of 0.88, 0.46, 0.03, and 0.24, respectively. The bars are colored in a dark blue hue. In the right chart, the x-axis is labeled "Max Ambiguity" and features three categories with values 1, 2, and 3, associated with Fleiss Kappa values of 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23, respectively. The bars in this chart are also colored in dark blue. Both charts display a decreasing trend in Fleiss Kappa as the respective ambiguity measures increase, with the tallest bar in each chart corresponding to the lowest ambiguity value and the shortest bar corresponding to the highest or second-highest ambiguity value. The bars are not sorted in any particular order beyond their categorical arrangement on the x-axis, and no bars are visually emphasized.
